drivingQuestion: What preparation does prayer require, and how far must one go — or what may he use instead — to have clean hands?
outcomeNote: Rava endorses the Westerner's ruling from the wording of Psalms 26:6, and the anonymous voice then fixes the limits: water is sought only for prayer, up to a parasang ahead and less than a mil behind.

segments.he: וְאָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: הָרוֹצֶה שֶׁיְּקַבֵּל עָלָיו עוֹל מַלְכוּת שָׁמַיִם שְׁלֵמָה
segments.en: «And Rabbi Yoḥanan said: One who seeks to accept upon himself the complete yoke of the kingdom of Heaven»

segments.he: יִפָּנֶה, וְיִטּוֹל יָדָיו, וְיַנִּיחַ תְּפִילִּין, וְיִקְרָא קְרִיאַת שְׁמַע, וְיִתְפַּלֵּל, וְזוֹ הִיא מַלְכוּת שָׁמַיִם שְׁלֵמָה.
segments.en: «should relieve himself, wash his hands, don phylacteries, recite Shema, and pray, and that is» acceptance of «the complete Kingdom of Heaven.»

segments.he: אָמַר רַבִּי חִיָּיא בַּר אַבָּא אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: כָּל הַנִּפְנֶה, וְנוֹטֵל יָדָיו, וּמַנִּיחַ תְּפִילִּין, וְקוֹרֵא קְרִיאַת שְׁמַע, וּמִתְפַּלֵּל — מַעֲלֶה עָלָיו הַכָּתוּב כְּאִלּוּ בָּנָה מִזְבֵּחַ וְהִקְרִיב עָלָיו קׇרְבָּן, דִּכְתִיב: ״אֶרְחַץ בְּנִקָּיוֹן כַּפָּי וַאֲסוֹבְבָה אֶת מִזְבַּחֲךָ ה׳״. אֲמַר לֵיהּ רָבָא: לָא סָבַר לַהּ מָר כְּאִילּוּ טָבַל, דִּכְתִיב: ״אֶרְחַץ [בְּנִקָּיוֹן]״ — וְלָא כָּתַב ״אַרְחִיץ [כַּפָּי]״.
segments.en: On a similar note, «Rabbi Ḥiyya bar Abba said» that «Rabbi Yoḥanan said: Anyone who relieves himself, washes his hands, dons phylacteries, recites Shema, and prays, the verse ascribes» credit «to him as if he built an altar and offered a sacrifice upon it, as it is written: “I will wash in purity my hands, and I will encircle the altar of the Lord”» (Psalms 26:6). «Rava said to him: Do you not maintain, Master,» that one who does so, «it is as if he immersed» his entire body, «as it is written: “I will wash in purity,” and it is not written: “I will wash my hands”?»

segments.he: אֲמַר לֵיהּ רָבִינָא לְרָבָא: חֲזִי מָר הַאי צוּרְבָּא מֵרַבָּנָן דַּאֲתָא מִמַּעְרְבָא וְאָמַר: מִי שֶׁאֵין לוֹ מַיִם לִרְחוֹץ יָדָיו — מְקַנֵּחַ יָדָיו בְּעָפָר וּבִצְרוֹר וּבְקִסְמִית.
segments.en: «Ravina said to Rava: My Master, look at this Torah scholar [tzurva merabbanan] who came from» Eretz Yisrael «and said» something astonishing: «One who has no water with which to wash his hands,» it is sufficient that «he wipes his hands with earth, a rock, or a sliver» of wood.

segments.he: אֲמַר לֵיהּ: שַׁפִּיר קָאָמַר, מִי כְּתִיב ״אֶרְחַץ בְּמַיִם״? ״בְּנִקָּיוֹן״ כְּתִיב — כֹּל מִידֵּי דִּמְנַקֵּי, דְּהָא רַב חִסְדָּא לָיֵיט אַמַּאן דִּמְהַדַּר אַמַּיָּא בְּעִידָּן צְלוֹתָא.
segments.en: Rava «replied to» Ravina: «He spoke well,» as, «is it written: I will wash with water? In purity, is written» referring to anything that cleans, «as Rav Ḥisda» would «curse one who» went out of his way «to seek water at the time of prayer.»

segments.he: וְהָנֵי מִילֵּי לִקְרִיאַת שְׁמַע, אֲבָל לִתְפִלָּה מְהַדַּר. וְעַד כַּמָּה? — עַד פַּרְסָה. וְהָנֵי מִילֵּי לְקַמֵּיהּ, אֲבָל לַאֲחוֹרֵיהּ — אֲפִילּוּ מִיל אֵינוֹ חוֹזֵר. [וּמִינַּהּ] מִיל הוּא דְּאֵינוֹ חוֹזֵר, הָא פָּחוֹת מִמִּיל — חוֹזֵר.
segments.en: With regard to seeking water, the Gemara comments: «This applies only to the recitation of Shema,» as the time for its recitation is limited, and if one goes seeking water he may run out of time. «However, for prayer,» which may be recited all day, «one» must go out of his way «to seek» water. «And how» far must one go out of his way to seek water? «As far as a parasang [parsa]. And this,» one parsa, «applies only before him but behind him, he need not return even one mil. From this» one may infer that «he need not return one mil, but one must return less than one mil.»
